text:
Fantastic first time pass this morning for Adam! 

Another pupil Keen On Driving at Nelson test Centre with only 3 driver faults! 

Excellent drive Adam! Good luck with finding a car! 😃🚗🎉🚦

It's also a sad day. Almost time to hang up the duels in the super reliable Hyundai i10! That was It's last test! 

But when the car is over 17 years old and older than some of my pupils 🤣, it's definitely time to get something newer! It will be sadly missed 😥
